scope: A default-off device-local activity-widget preference and real read-only panel display only accepted friends' already-authorized global game activity. Server-only grants are never reinterpreted as global grants. Blocked, offline/invisible/unknown, revoked/tombstoned and stale-account data are excluded. At most five cards contain only userId, display label and game name, without process paths, URLs, timestamps or join actions.

Projection subscribes to the existing account-scoped epoch-fenced activity store, friendships, outgoing blocks and live presence. Native publication additionally gates cached rows on connected WebSocket state. Existing useGameActivity already clears the activity store when disconnected; this change tightens publication ordering rather than claiming that earlier clients retained rows throughout offline periods.

Strict native IPC validates/project cards, enforces uniqueness, control-character/text bounds and five-card cap. Native geometry reserves header/row space, reduces rows to physical workarea limits and reapplies those limits on lock/unlock deliveries. The action-only renderer receives no activity cards or voice roster.

Activity works independently from a current voice roster. An enabled empty panel states that no shared activity is visible. Maximum voice-user Off now hides the voice list only; enabled quick actions/activity remain independent, while the master switch disables everything. Game mode still requires supported foreground tracking and explicit registered-executable overlay permission; no local process inventory is sent to the server.
This is a partial widget slice. The composite seven-widget acceptance remains missing; notifications/chat/video/streams and independently movable widget layouts are not claimed complete.
